environment: Ubuntu under WSL2, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070, 12 GB VRAM
coarse_scan: All twelve 200 fm/c GPU trajectories ran sequentially. The final part of the scan overlapped a strict CPU fresh-field static probe.
fine_scan: Four 200 fm/c GPU trajectories ran sequentially. The separate 20 fm/c CPU/GPU equivalence controls overlapped the beginning of this scan.
fine_short_controls_cpu_affinity: The complete short-control runner was launched with taskset -c 8-15; both its CPU and GPU host work inherit that affinity.
timing_interpretation: Recorded seconds are diagnostic execution costs under these loads. They must not be used to claim a new CPU/GPU speedup or replace the existing sequential repeated benchmark.
numerical_interpretation: Independent process directories and immutable copied seeds were used. Concurrency affects throughput; no process shares its wavefunctions or Hamiltonian fields with another calculation. Endpoint scientific checks are performed on each process's own checkpoint.
